description: Ensure skill does not contain bash-specific or mixed-shell constructs incompatible across Windows PowerShell and POSIX shells
explanation: Bash-specific redirections, mixed PowerShell/Bash chaining (2>$null ||), and multi-line backslash continuations fail across shells.

description: Ensure PR review mode avoids destructive branch checkout in active workspace
explanation: Direct checkout overwrites uncommitted user files and alters working tree state.

description: Ensure automated APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES reviews require explicit human confirmation
explanation: AI reviews must not auto-submit binding approvals or change requests without user sign-off.

description: Ensure skill advises against reading all changed files in full for large diffs and covers untracked files
prohibited_patterns: Read each changed file in full
explanation: Reading all changed files in full causes context exhaustion and token throttling, while ignoring untracked files misses newly added code.

description: Ensure validation phase promotes targeted testing on the PR head (worktree/CI) rather than blind runs on the wrong branch
explanation: Targeted testing accelerates feedback and must run against the PR branch/worktree or inspect CI checks.

description: Ensure PR metadata fetches draft/state/url fields and batch inline comments specify valid payload schema and cleanup
explanation: Draft PR detection requires isDraft in gh pr view, and GitHub review API requires a JSON object with a comments array.
